Taking suprema gives s2 Insertion thus annihilates null vectors, descends to the quotient, and extends uniquely with norm at most Q. This is OS/Train.producer. For general d, use d′ = am⌊d/am⌋. Since am < r/32, the same word lies in the narrower slab with buffer r/2. Compose its operator on the right with the heat contraction of width d −d′. On plants this is exactly the required insertion at width d, and its norm does not increase. The empty word is the heat contraction. All intermediate choices give the same operator because they agree on the dense plants. Replacing r by r/2 only enlarges C, proving (BS1) for one common family of operators. This is the padding and uniqueness argument of OS/Halves and Work/B01.
